title: A loader balancing on two wheels in the news becomes a wheelie game the same evening
summary: On Tue 17 Nov at 19:24Z @eriskii.net (3,060 followers) posted "holy shit" with an image (205 likes, 20 quotes). A member's quote post links the news item behind it, headed "AI teaches five-tonne loader to balance on two wheels". At 20:50Z @cee.wtf (2,524 followers) quote-posted it with "list of unpredictable things but are obvious in hindsight". At 21:00Z @shimmermathlabs.com replied: ""trained in simulation" / you know what that means? / realistic tractor wheelie sim game is possible"; another member added "tractor qwop". At 23:51Z, 2 hours 51 minutes after that suggestion, @cee.wtf posted a video with "do a sick wheelie at yard-shift.cee.wtf" (122 likes, 15 reposts). A player wrote that the left and right buttons sit too close together on a phone "for people with big thumbs"; the maker replied "giving myself the "didnt even consider people on mobile" award once again", and the player answered "I can't bring my desktop in my forklift". At 00:10Z @shimmermathlabs.com asked for three things: "i want skid marks on the ground / i want to be a driver inside that can hang off edge or jump out during tricks for extra points / i want a button for hoots and woots". At 00:31Z, 21 minutes later, the maker replied "done" with an image. The requester's next post has a screenshot whose alt text describes the result: a yellow skid steer loader tipped back on its rear wheels, a small worker in a high-vis vest hanging off the side, "Woot!" floating at the top of the screen, tire skid marks on a concrete yard.

made.what: yard-shift: a browser game about doing wheelies in a skid steer loader

couldBeShown: From the one alt text that describes it: "a cartoony 3D construction game"; a yellow skid steer loader with a black frame and a caged cab "tipped back onto its rear wheels, nose in the air, its arms fully extended so the bucket is up overhead"; two loose wheels in the bucket; a small worker in an orange high-vis vest and yellow hard hat hanging off the side; a "Woot!" message; a concrete yard with tire skid marks, a chain-link fence and low-poly trees under a gray sky. The maker's own video and image have no alt text.

sensitive: The starting point is outside news about a machine; the bible keeps such news in scope only as the cluster's reaction, which here is a game. The thread around it also holds posts about what such machines mean for people's jobs (R10) and a post the digest keyword-flags; none is carried. The last carried post says "there has to be a way to run yourself over": it is about the game's driver figure, and R10 lists accidents, so it may be better left unread. The maker's "award" line is self-teasing. @shimmermathlabs.com is marked featuredPrevious: shown. @cee.wtf holds the Top Chicken record and one of the window's results (games lane), and also appears in made-polykatamari and made-build-bot-small-wishes.
notUnderstood: "qwop" / "QWOP mode": a reference to a browser game known for hard-to-control limbs, as research reads it.
